title: Oven Baked Australian Lamb Bake
description: A comforting Australian dish featuring lamb, pita bread, and a rich molten sauce, baked to perfection in a ramekin.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the diced lamb, chopped onion, minced garlic, and chopped rosemary.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the tomato paste and olive oil.
Add the tomato paste mixture to the lamb mixture and stir until the lamb is well coated.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper.
Divide the pita bread pieces among 4 ramekins.
Spoon the lamb mixture over the pita bread in each ramekin.
Bake the ramekins in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the ramekins from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
